cards.front: Recall a key point about Combinational Logic Systems
cards.back: Combinational logic produces outputs determined solely by current inputs, with no memory or feedback.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Combinational Logic Systems
cards.back: A half adder adds two single-bit binary numbers, producing Sum (XOR) and Carry (AND).

cards.front: Recall a key point about Combinational Logic Systems
cards.back: A full adder adds three bits (two inputs plus carry-in), producing Sum and Carry-out using two half adders and an OR gate.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Combinational Logic Systems
cards.back: Sum = A ⊕ B ⊕ C_in; Carry-out = A·B + C_in·(A ⊕ B).

cards.front: Recall a key point about Combinational Logic Systems
cards.back: Multiple full adders can be cascaded to build multi-bit ripple-carry adders.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Combinational Logic Systems
cards.back: A multiplexer (MUX) selects one of several inputs and routes it to a single output, controlled by select lines.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Combinational Logic Systems
cards.back: A 2ⁿ-to-1 MUX has n select lines and 2ⁿ data inputs.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Combinational Logic Systems
cards.back: A decoder converts a binary input on n lines to one of 2ⁿ output lines being active (e.g. 3-to-8 decoder).

cards.front: Recall a key point about Combinational Logic Systems
cards.back: An encoder performs the reverse of a decoder: it converts active input lines into a binary code output.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Combinational Logic Systems
cards.back: Priority encoders resolve conflicts when multiple inputs are active by selecting the highest-priority input.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Combinational Logic Systems
cards.back: Comparators compare two binary numbers and output whether A > B, A = B or A < B.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Combinational Logic Systems
cards.back: Combinational circuits can be analysed by writing the Boolean expression from the gate diagram or deriving a truth table.

cards.back: 1. For Combinational Logic Systems questions, use correct electronic symbols and terminology 2. Always show your working in calculations, including units at each step 3.
